## English

### Xcode 27 build fix (iOS)

- Fixed an iOS build failure with Xcode 27 in 10.56.0–10.57.0 (#645). The privacy manifest's resource bundle target (`react-native-update-react-native-update_privacy`) got the podspec's hard-coded `11.0` deployment target. React Native's `post_install` does not raise resource bundle targets, and Xcode 27 rejects deployment targets below iOS 15.0. The pod now uses React Native's `min_ios_version_supported`.
- Expo projects were not affected. There are no runtime changes; run `pod install` after upgrading.
- If you cannot upgrade yet, set `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` to `15.1` for the `react-native-update-react-native-update_privacy` target in your Podfile's `post_install`.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/reactnativecn/react-native-update/compare/v10.57.0...v10.57.1)

## 中文

### Xcode 27 编译修复（iOS）

- 修复 10.56.0～10.57.0 在 Xcode 27 下 iOS 编译失败的问题（#645）。隐私清单资源包 target（`react-native-update-react-native-update_privacy`）沿用了 podspec 写死的 `11.0` 部署版本。React Native 的 `post_install` 不会调整资源包 target，而 Xcode 27 不接受低于 iOS 15.0 的部署版本。现在改为使用 React Native 的 `min_ios_version_supported`。
- Expo 工程不受影响。本版本没有运行时改动，升级后重新执行 `pod install` 即可。
- 暂时无法升级的，可以在 Podfile 的 `post_install` 里把 `react-native-update-react-native-update_privacy` target 的 `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` 设为 `15.1`。

[完整变更记录](https://github.com/reactnativecn/react-native-update/compare/v10.57.0...v10.57.1)
